text:
Ana (partnerships): Quick sync — we need a lean private-offer structure for AWS/GCP marketplace. Focus: commitment buckets, renewal incentives, and SI uplift. Draft sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace-private-offers (view only). Who can take a stab at a simple matrix?
Mike (sales): I can. thinking 3 buckets to start: 10k, 50k, 200k ARR-equivalent commits? keeps ops simple. :thumbsup:
Rachel (finance): Prefer annual commitment tiers (not monthly) so we can model revenue recognition. initial discount ideas: 10% / 18% / 28% depending on prepay + term. Need a P&L sensitivity.
Sam (legal): Heads up — AWS private offers have constraints on renewal language and auto-apply promos. I'll check the marketplace T&Cs and flag any no-nos. We should avoid blanket auto-renew without explicit consent.
Priya (alliances): For SI partners: recommend 8-12% co-sell credit on committed portion, plus a fixed onboarding rebate for first 90 days. Also require SI to commit to a joint announcement or enablement playbook.
Kevin (product): A question — do we tie SLA/latency guarantees to discount level? higher discounts imply more capacity priority. ops impact is real.
Ana (partnerships): Good Q. My proposal: discounts tied to commit+prepay, but SLA priority as separate checkbox (paid addon). keeps pricing matrix simpler.
Mike (sales): What about renewal incentives? e.g., extra 3-5% if customer ups or maintains >=90% of committed usage in year 1. That helps retention.
Rachel (finance): We can model a Year 2 kicker: if usage >=80% of committed in last 90 days, apply +5% discount year 2, capped at 30% total. Also carveouts for non-linear usage (embeddings spikes).
Sam (legal): Audit clause needed for usage verification. Also include a clause for hardware partner credits — if customer uses partner infra resale, terms change. I'll draft standard language.
Priya (alliances): For pilots: suggest we run on AWS first with 2 SI partners (CloudWave, IntegrateCo). Pilot objectives: validate onboarding flow, invoice flow, and co-sell credit mechanics. Timeline: Q2 kickoff.
marketplace-bot: Created private-offer draft: PO-2026-042 (internal). Link: https://marketplace.internal/offers/PO-2026-042
Ana (partnerships): I'm pasting a barebones CSV matrix to iterate on — please edit the sheet instead of pasting here:
```
bucket,annual_commit,prepay,discount,si_co_sell,renewal_kicker,notes
small,10000,none,10%,8%,+3% if >=90% usage,12 month term
medium,50000,50% prepay,18%,10%,+5% if >=85% usage,annual billing
large,200000,100% prepay,28%,12%,+5% if >=80% usage,total commitment w/ SLAs
```
Mike (sales): I'll populate with example deal math and 3 real accounts we could pilot with.
Rachel (finance): I'll run the 3-yr P&L and ARR churn sensitivity by Friday. Need assumptions from Mike by EOD Tue.
Sam (legal): I'll produce a 1-page template for private-offer terms (audit, renewals, HW credits, SI credits).
Priya (alliances): I'll reach out to CloudWave & IntegrateCo and confirm interest. Will surface partner MSA items.
Kevin (product): Ops note: if we offer priority routing for large commits, eng-runtime needs a config flag; I'll sync with runtime on perf SLOs.
Ana (partnerships): Actions captured. I'll create a working session (1h) — propose Wed 10am PT. Who's in?
Mike (sales): In.
Rachel (finance): In.
Sam (legal): In.
Priya (alliances): In.
Kevin (product): Likely in, will confirm.
Ana (partnerships): Thanks all. Small ask — use the shared sheet for edits and add a short comment when you change numbers. We'll finalize pilot offer and send to marketplace in two weeks. :rocket:
